decks.notes: The deck is centered around quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith, Burning Inquiry, and Faithless Looting to bring out powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine for aggressive plays. Detective's Phoenix and Marauding Mako provide additional threats, while Lightning Bolt offers removal options. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Elegant Parlor and Arena of Glory. The key strategy is to capitalize on the graveyard mechanic and keep the pressure on the opponent.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can protect its creatures, retrigger their abilities, and keep the pressure on the opponent. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By playing powerful threats like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, combined with Leyline of the Guildpact to reduce mana costs, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additional support from cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Stubborn Denial help protect your board and maintain tempo. The deck also includes a few versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to deal with opposing threats.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, along with powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck aims to apply pressure and generate value through repeated enter the battlefield triggers. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push are included to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional utility and protection for your creatures. The deck's strategy revolves around creating a fast and disruptive board presence to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to take advantage of their enter the battlefield abilities. By repeatedly blinking creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, you can generate massive value and overwhelm your opponent. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional disruption and protection, while cards like Solitude and Fatal Push help control the board. Thoughtseize and Quantum Riddler help disrupt your opponent's game plan, allowing you to maintain tempo and pressure. With a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and outvalue your opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing graveyard manipulation, discard spells, and removal to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to abuse the graveyard with cards like Necrodominance and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, generating advantages while also applying pressure with creatures like Boggart Trawler and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes protection like Dauthi Voidwalker and Witherbloom Charm to deal with threats effectively. By stripping the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and utilizing removal like Fatal Push and Force of Despair, the deck aims to maintain control and out-value the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones, and then reanimate them using cards like Persist and Unearth. Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek help disrupt the opponent's strategy, while Faithless Looting and Thought Scour provide card advantage and help further fill the graveyard. Fatal Push is included for removal, and Abhorrent Oculus and Psychic Frog can provide additional value through their abilities. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Birthing Ritual card to ramp up and play powerful creatures quickly, while also disrupting the opponent with counter spells and control elements. The deck includes a mix of creatures with enter-the-battlefield effects and disruption spells to maintain board presence and hinder the opponent's game plan. The combination of aggro creatures, ramp spells, and control elements creates a versatile and aggressive strategy that aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's board through various removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Force of Despair, you can clear threats and stall the game until you can bring out powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Soul Spike. Utilizing the graveyard and sacrificing creatures for value are key elements of this deck, allowing you to outvalue and outlast your opponent in a drawn-out game.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of Broodscale Bloodchief with Blade of the Bloodchief, Sowing Mycospawn, and Malevolent Rumble to generate massive amounts of mana and deal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to ramp up and find key pieces of the combo, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Unholy Heat and Kozilek's Command. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and generate an insurmountable advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi. It aims to maintain board control and card advantage while gradually grinding down the opponent's resources. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion adds an additional threat to the deck, providing a creature that can pressure the opponent and provide additional utility. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to establish and maintain control over the game, while gradually building towards a win condition.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and graveyard hate. It also aims to generate card advantage through creatures with powerful enter the battlefield effects and card draw abilities. The deck utilizes a mix of versatile removal spells, efficient hand disruption, and powerful creatures to maintain control of the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run. Additionally, the mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for the spells in the deck.

This deck is focused on utilizing artifacts and legendary creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and disruption. By mixing powerful artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal with creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Cori-Steel Cutter, the deck aims to create a fast and efficient board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Metallic Rebuke and Unholy Heat provide control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes versatile cards like Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to further enhance its aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on using powerful instant spells to reanimate creatures from the graveyard quickly in order to create a combo win condition. By utilizing cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, the player can quickly bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand to dominate the game. The deck also contains disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the board and protect the combo pieces. With a mix of graveyard recursion and control, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast-paced reanimation strategy.

The main goal of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with counter spells, removal cards, and hand disruption. The deck focuses on using cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Force of Negation to keep the opponent's board clear while also utilizing cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Subtlety to generate card advantage and maintain control. The deck also includes ways to manipulate the opponent's hand and graveyard with cards like Cling to Dust and Sheoldred's Edict, ultimately aiming to grind out the opponent and establish dominance on the battlefield.

This deck focuses on controlling the game and ramping up Eldrazi creatures to dominate the battlefield. With a combination of mana acceleration and disruptive spells, it aims to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi like Emrakul and Ulamog to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes ways to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy, creating a strong Control-Eldrazi Ramp synergy. By carefully managing resources and timing, the deck can quickly establish a dominant board presence and secure victory.
